# Construct the BIBD(13,4,3) using the projective plane of order 3 repeated 3 times
v = 13
b = 39
k = 4
r = 12
lam = 3

# Base block from difference set {0,1,3,9} mod 13
base = {0, 1, 3, 9}

# Build incidence matrix
matrix = []
for i in range(v):
    row = []
    for j in range(b):
        block_index = j % v  # 0..12
        # translate base by block_index
        block = {(x + block_index) % v for x in base}
        row.append(1 if i in block else 0)
    matrix.append(row)

# Verify constraints
import itertools

# Row sums
row_sums = [sum(row) for row in matrix]
print("Row sums:", row_sums)
print("All row sums == r?", all(s == r for s in row_sums))

# Column sums
col_sums = [sum(matrix[i][j] for i in range(v)) for j in range(b)]
print("Column sums:", col_sums[:13], "...", col_sums[-13:])
print("All col sums == k?", all(s == k for s in col_sums))

# Pairwise inner products
ok = True
for i1 in range(v):
    for i2 in range(i1+1, v):
        inner = sum(matrix[i1][j] * matrix[i2][j] for j in range(b))
        if inner != lam:
            print(f"Pair ({i1},{i2}) inner product = {inner}")
            ok = False
            break
    if not ok:
        break
print("All pairwise inner products == lambda?", ok)

# Flatten
flat = [matrix[i][j] for i in range(v) for j in range(b)]
print("Length:", len(flat))
print("First 39:", flat[:39])
print("Next 39:", flat[39:78])
